landing.title: Your health history, in one place that follows you.
landing.sub: MedChain keeps every prescription, pharmacy bill and lab report on one timeline. A doctor sees your full history only when you say yes.
landing.problem: Prescriptions get lost. Bills fade. Reports sit in a drawer. Your doctor starts from zero.
landing.s1d: Take a photo of a prescription or bill, or send it on WhatsApp. Labs and pharmacies can add theirs directly.
landing.s2d: Lab reports are read automatically. Values outside the range printed on the report are marked High or Low. MedChain never diagnoses.
landing.s3t: Your doctor sees it, with your OK
landing.s3d: A code sent to your phone gives a doctor access for 24 hours. You can end it any time and see who looked.
landing.forTitle: Made for everyone in the care chain
landing.f1d: One timeline in English or Hindi, with large text and simple screens.
landing.f2d: See past visits, medicines and flagged lab values in under ten seconds.
landing.f3d: Upload reports and bills straight to the patient's timeline, after consent.
landing.p1d: No doctor sees anything without your code. Access ends in 24 hours, or sooner if you revoke it.
landing.p2d: See which doctor looked at your records, and when.
landing.p3d: Only a fingerprint of each file goes on the Solana blockchain. Medical details never do, and your Aadhaar number is never stored.
landing.p4d: Your uploaded files and your WhatsApp assistant's memory can be deleted.
landing.foot: Prototype with fake data only. Built for the SEVA FIRST Innovation Challenge 2026.
landing.demoFlag: Outside the range printed on the report
landing.demoAsk: Dr. Demo Sharma wants to view your records
landing.demoPause: Demo plays on its own. Tap a tab to choose a step.
landing.q1: Does MedChain store my Aadhaar number?
landing.a1: No. Only a scrambled identifier is kept, never the number itself. This prototype simulates the OTP step.
landing.q2: Can a doctor see my records without asking me?
landing.a2: No. A doctor needs the code sent to your phone. Access ends after 24 hours, and you can end it sooner.
landing.a3: Only a fingerprint (hash) of each file and of each consent. Never names, reports or images.
landing.a4: No. It only reads the numbers from a report. Simple code then checks each value against the range printed on your report.
